notes.title: Alien Arena 7.71.7 Linux update
notes.content:
This applies to Linux only. This release contains the following changes:

[list]
[*]Automatic and ultra-fast installation of map packs before loading a map (by default enabled)
[*]Fixed bug that could cause crashes in single player mode
[*]Added Discord button in the main menu to easily join the Discord server
[*]Fixed a map difference error bug after reinstalling a map
[*]Added possibility to change the sky in a map without causing map difference errors
[*]Removed the sponsor banner
[*]Increased default time that messages appear in the screen to 6 seconds and can be changed and remembered now
[/list]

notes.title: Patch for crashes in single player mode
notes.content: This fixes the bug that crashes occurred in single player mode.

notes.title: Alien Arena 7.71.7 - Several updates
notes.content:
Release notes for this release:

[list]
[*] Automatic and ultra-fast installation of map packs before loading a map (by default enabled)
[*] Fixed bug that could cause crashes in single player mode (as patch)
[*] Added Discord button in the main menu to easily join the Discord server
[*] Fixed a map difference error bug after reinstalling a map
[*] Added option to override the sky from the fog script (only relevant to mappers)
[*] Removed the sponsor banner
[*] Increased default time that messages appear in the screen to 6 seconds and can be changed and remembered now
[*] We (re)released a bunch of new maps. You can find them on https://www.alienarena.org
[/list]


Note:
This update only applies to windows users. Linux users can install Alien Arena 7.71.7 from Flathub: https://flathub.org/apps/org.alienarena.alienarena

See also other alternatives on https://www.alienarena.org

notes.title: Alien Arena 7.71.6 - Several updates
notes.content:
Alien Arena 7.71.6 has been released!
Several updates have been done:

[list]
[*] There is now a filter in the server list to show active servers only
[*] It's easier to see the number of real players in the server list
[*] The server list sorts on player count + ping by default
[*] The newsfeed can show colors now
[*] The antilag code has been optimized
[/list]


[i]Note:
This only applies to windows users. Linux users can find alternative ways on [url=https://www.alienarena.org]https://www.alienarena.org[/url].[/i]

notes.title: Several updates are live now!
notes.content:
This update applies only to windows users, for now.
Linux users can take a look at the workaround or alternatives described at https://www.alienarena.org


It's now possible to very easily download and install 3rd party maps hosted on https://www.alienarena.org  by just using the installmap command from the console in the game.
Next to this, all game operations are now hosted on alienarena.org, also irc moved to irc.alienarena.org. You shouldn't notice any difference regarding these changes.

Also some bugs have been fixed:
[list]
[*] Downloading maps is using the http protocol again instead of udp, so much faster downloading.
[*] The newsfeed is working again.
[*] The old obsolete in-game stats have been removed.
[/list]

notes.title: Alien Arena - Official Update is out now!
notes.content:
Major update to Alien Arena is on Steam today!

This update adds two new maps, CTF-Dynasty and CTF-Terminal, and includes the many updates we've done to the game since the initial release in terms of bug fixes, graphical features, and improvements to the Tactical game.

We come in peace! (not really)

notes.title: Another big update coming!
notes.content:
An update will be coming in the next month that focuses very heavily on new content, and some more polish.  

The major focus is on new maps, particularly CTF and Tactical.  There will be 3 new CTF maps, including remakes of Terminal and Stronghold, as well as a brand new design.  Stronghold and the new map will also have Tactical versions.

We have been made aware of some occasional "hitches" occuring when a player first begins playing, and are tracking down the source of the problem.  This will be corrected in this update as well.  There are a few other items being looked at that will add to the gameplay experience.
